title: Caterpillar is bringing to AI deployment what it learned from automating mining | TechCrunch
summary: And like nearly every other company, Caterpillar is using AI across its enterprise operations, as well as for software development. “We use AI agents to modernize legacy code, generate and test new software, and identify defects earlier,” Mineart said.
